pull.title: cmake: Reject warnings in `check_cxx_source_compiles_with_flags()`, use `-msse4.1` for SHA-NI
pull.body:
This is a prerequisite for #31507.

1. The first commit fixes a bug in the C++ atomic library check:
```console
$ git rev-parse HEAD
01b51c0f1fa8af242fc37891d666c3d940045d80
$ cmake -B build -DAPPEND_CXXFLAGS="-Wall -Werror" 2>&1 | grep -A 8 STD_ATOMIC
-- Performing Test STD_ATOMIC_LINKS_WITHOUT_LIBATOMIC
-- Performing Test STD_ATOMIC_LINKS_WITHOUT_LIBATOMIC - Failed
-- Performing Test STD_ATOMIC_NEEDS_LINK_TO_LIBATOMIC
-- Performing Test STD_ATOMIC_NEEDS_LINK_TO_LIBATOMIC - Failed
CMake Error at cmake/module/TestAppendRequiredLibraries.cmake:91 (message):
  Cannot figure out how to use std::atomic.
Call Stack (most recent call first):
  cmake/introspection.cmake:23 (test_append_atomic_library)
  CMakeLists.txt:453 (include)


-- Configuring incomplete, errors occurred!
```

2. The second commit fixes a bug in the ARMv8 SHA-NI check:
```console

        Run Build Command(s): /usr/bin/cmake -E env VERBOSE=1 /usr/bin/gmake -f Makefile cmTC_b4026/fast
        /usr/bin/gmake  -f CMakeFiles/cmTC_b4026.dir/build.make CMakeFiles/cmTC_b4026.dir/build

        Building CXX object CMakeFiles/cmTC_b4026.dir/src.cxx.o

            7 |       vsha256h2q_u32(a, b, c);
              |       ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~^~~~~~~~~
```

3. We expect that neither the compiler flags nor the test source triggers any warnings, such as `-Wunknown-argument`. Therefore, append `working_compiler_werror_flag`, as done in [`try_append_cxx_flags()`](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/blob/master/cmake/module/TryAppendCXXFlags.cmake).

4. `-msse4` is merely a synonym for `-msse4.2` in both GCC and Clang, but it is not accepted by the clang-cl frontend. Furthermore, the x86 SHA-NI code uses only SSE4.1 intrinsics and no SSE4.2 ones.

Replace `-msse4` with `-msse4.1` to resolve both issues.

The absence of SSE4.2 usage can be verified by building with `-DAPPEND_CXXFLAGS=-mno-sse4.2`.

cmake: Add `[[maybe_unused]]` annotation to atomic library check

The check fails when `-Wall -Werror` are provided by the user as the
unused `d1` variable triggers `-Wunused-variable`. Since the fallback
check with `LINK_LIBRARIES atomic` compiles the same source, it fails
too, and configuration aborts with "Cannot figure out how to use
std::atomic."

cmake: Initialize variables in ARMv8 SHA-NI check

The check fails when `-Wall -Werror` are provided by the user as
uninitialized `uint32x4_t` arguments trigger `-Wuninitialized`. This
results in disabling the ARMv8 SHA-NI code path.

This is also a prerequisite for the following commit.
